name: research-toolkit
description: Online research skills. Ships /research-toolkit:deep-research (multi-agent web research → cited HTML report), /research-toolkit:ux-research (UX research → live-rendered UI variation mockups, with /ui-research as alias), and /research-toolkit:price-estimate (competitive pricing research → pessimistic price estimate with competitor analysis). All reports land in /tmp/claude-research/ and open in the default browser.
